title: Exact localization of the clopen comparison square
statement: Given four abelian categories with derived categories, exact additive functors G,L,L′,G′, and a natural transformation σ:G L′→L G′, clopenLocalizedSquare descends σ to unbounded derived categories using the canonical exact-functor composition comparisons. clopenLocalizedSquarePlus is its bounded-below counterpart. These are the prescribed exact localization constructions; their factorization equations follow from localization.

source.place: Tag 0F7B, first proof paragraph; categorical construction implementing its prescribed comparison.

proof.text: Construct the square by composing the inverse exact composition comparison, the localization lift of the termwise natural transformation, and the target exact composition comparison. In D+ use the homotopy localization and its lifting instances. These are the same terms as the original geometric derivedAlpha definitions, with abstract functors as parameters.
